tagline: Trusted partner providing life insurance, health protection, and asset management solutions across Asia and Africa.
hero_kpi_rationale: Prudential generated $2.78 billion in new business profit in 2025, growing 13% at constant exchange rates. This metric reflects the company's ability to expand its portfolio of new contracts in its key Asian and African markets, demonstrating the sustainability of its growth trajectory.

kpis.name: New Business Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by the company's new business measured on a traditional embedded value basis (TEV).
kpis.description: Prudential generated $2.78 billion in new business profit in 2025, up 13% compared to 2024 at constant exchange rates.
kpis.signal: Double-digit new business profit growth confirming commercial momentum.

kpis.name: APE (Annual Premium Equivalent) Sales
kpis.explanation: Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) sales measuring the volume of new business in standardized terms.
kpis.description: Prudential generated $6.66 billion in APE sales in 2025, up 7% at constant exchange rates compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Sustained APE sales growth reflecting demand for life and protection insurance solutions.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit measuring the core operational profitability of the business.
kpis.description: Prudential generated $3.31 billion in adjusted operating profit in 2025, up 6% at constant exchange rates.
kpis.signal: Growth in adjusted operating profit demonstrating improved operational profitability.

kpis.name: Eastspring Assets Under Management or Advised
kpis.explanation: Total assets under management or advised by Eastspring, Prudential's asset management division.
kpis.description: Eastspring managed or advised $277.7 billion in assets in 2025, up 8% at constant exchange rates.
kpis.signal: Growth in assets under management reflecting demand for investment solutions.

kpis.name: IFRS Shareholders' Equity
kpis.explanation: Shareholders' equity under IFRS standards, measuring book value.
kpis.description: IFRS shareholders' equity reached $20.1 billion in 2025, up 15% compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Double-digit equity growth confirming shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: Operating Free Surplus Generated
kpis.explanation: Free surplus cash flow generated by in-force insurance and asset management operations.
kpis.description: Prudential generated $3.06 billion in operating free surplus in 2025, up 15% compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Robust operational cash flow generation supporting shareholder distributions.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend amount paid per share to shareholders.
kpis.description: Prudential paid a dividend of 26.60 cents per share in 2025, up 15% from 23.13 cents in 2024.
kpis.signal: 15% dividend per share growth reflecting capital allocation discipline.

kpis.name: IFRS Profit After Tax
kpis.explanation: Net profit under IFRS standards, measuring overall accounting profitability.
kpis.description: Prudential generated $4.12 billion in IFRS profit after tax in 2025, up 71% at constant exchange rates compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong IFRS profit growth driven by revaluation gains and operational improvement.

kpis.name: Present Value of New Business Premiums (PVNBP)
kpis.explanation: Present value of premiums associated with new business, measuring the future value of growth.
kpis.description: Prudential generated $31.93 billion in PVNBP in 2025, up 10% at constant exchange rates.
kpis.signal: 10% PVNBP growth demonstrating the quality and volume of new business.

kpis.name: TEV Shareholders' Equity Per Share
kpis.explanation: Embedded value of shareholders' equity per share, measuring value created for each shareholder.
kpis.description: TEV shareholders' equity per share reached $14.83 in 2025, up 15% compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: 15% growth in TEV per share confirming shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: New Business Profit Growth Momentum
kpis.explanation: Double-digit growth in new business profit demonstrating sustained commercial momentum.
kpis.description: Prudential recorded 13% new business profit growth in 2025, driven by higher volumes of new business and improved margins in its key Asian and African markets, confirming the company's double-digit growth trajectory.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in new business profit reflecting sustained momentum and market opportunity capture.

kpis.name: Eastspring Asset Growth Trajectory
kpis.explanation: Growth in assets under management or advised by Eastspring, reflecting momentum in the asset management segment.
kpis.description: Eastspring increased its assets under management or advised to $277.7 billion in 2025, up 8% at constant exchange rates. This growth is supported by rising demand for investment solutions in Asian markets and the group's strong asset management capabilities.
kpis.signal: Funds under management growth of 8% driven by positive net flows and market appreciation across Asian markets.

risks.title: Dependence on performance in Asian and African markets
risks.score_rationale: Major risk implicitly mentioned in strategy (20 markets in Asia-Africa). Moderate language but extreme geographic concentration (>90% of revenues). Stable but structural trend. High weight: concentrated exposure to geopolitical instability and regional economic cycles.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risk across multiple jurisdictions
risks.score_rationale: Operations in 20 jurisdictions with distinct insurance and solvency regimes. Strong language: 'regulatory and solvency regimes applicable across the Group'. Upward trend: increasing requirements (IFRS17, TEV reporting). Critical weight: direct impact on capital, pricing, and distribution.

risks.title: Technological transformation and AI deployment
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited emerging risk: 'develop and embed near-term commercial applications of AI' and 'scaling responsibly within robust cybersecurity, data protection and ethical governance frameworks'. Cautious language but acknowledges challenges. Upward trend: strategic priority for 2026-27. Moderate-to-high weight: growing reliance on systems.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and customer data protection
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the context of AI and technological transformation. Strong language: 'robust cybersecurity, data protection'. Upward trend: risk increasing with digitization. High weight: 17+ million customers, sensitive data, critical operations.

risks.title: Agent network performance and productivity
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified critical business risk: 'Improving agency performance remains a core strategic imperative' and 'focus on quality recruitment, activation and productivity'. Strong and repeated language. Upward trend: persistent issue despite efforts. Very high weight: agents are the primary distribution channel.

risks.title: Increased competition in life insurance and asset management
risks.score_rationale: Implied in differentiation strategy (health, protection, technology). Moderate language but clear competitive context (top 3-5 in 9 markets). Stable trend but growing pressure. High weight: margins and market share at stake.

risks.title: Reputational risk related to ESG practices and energy transition
risks.score_rationale: Explicit ESG commitment: 'Financing the Transition (FTT) framework', climate and nature investments. Positive language but risk of greenwashing or inconsistency. Upward trend: rising stakeholder expectations. Moderate weight: impact on customer and talent appeal.

risks.title: Dependence on bancassurance and third-party partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Key strategy: 'Deepening bancassurance partnerships' and 'exclusive bancassurance partnerships'. Moderate language but structural dependence. Stable trend. Moderate-to-high weight: critical channel for growth.

ai_positioning.summary: Prudential highlights the importance of innovation and adaptation to societal changes, including aging populations and evolving global retirement systems, but does not specifically address AI as a growth driver or key investment area in the provided documents.
evidence: Our mission is to be the most trusted partner and protector for this generation and generations to come, by providing simple and accessible financial and health solutions.
Our businesses are leveraging major societal changes, including aging populations, and evolving retirement systems across the world to further position the company for sustainable, long-term growth.
Our clear and simple strategy focuses on high-quality, sustainable growth, disciplined capital allocation and delivering long-term shareholder value.
